annotation.title_clean: NAIS - 국가인공지능전략위원회 (Presidential Council on National Artificial Intelligence Strategy)
annotation.title_en: Presidential Council on National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (NAIS)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Presidential Council on National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (Republic of Korea)
annotation.summary_en: English landing page of South Korea's Presidential Council on National AI Strategy, the presidentially chaired central coordinating body for AI policy. It lists four guiding principles: people-centered inclusive AI, whole-of-nation public–private partnership, AI-friendly systems, and balanced regional development. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Council chaired by the President serves as central coordinating authority for AI policy
Deliberates strategic directions and major policies for AI advancement and a trust-based AI ecosystem
Four principles: people-centered inclusive AI, public–private partnership, AI-friendly systems, balanced national development
Vision: genuine growth, improved quality of life, contribution to humanity
